messages:
alex m: Opening follow-up for Voyager postmortem. Primary issues: intermittent VPC peer drops + controller race causing tenant route staleness. Need owners, timelines, verification plan.

julia ops: Copying the summary: repeated peer reconnects caused overlapping KV syncs; controller cleanup removed active routes for short windows. Observed twice in prod this month.

sanjay r: I'll take the controller work. Plan: add per-peer KV sync mutex, 15s debounce before route prune after peer restart, and safelist for recently restarted peers. Will RFC + PR. ETA RFC 2026-06-01, PR 2026-06-05.

maria g: I'll handle vendor/network: confirm router model and whether graceful-restart flag or firmware patch is available. Target vendor writeup and maintenance window options by 2026-05-30.

nick support: I'll coordinate customer comms and gather preferred maintenance windows; will also prepare rollback notes.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary cluster provisioned 1761115000 with metrics and debug logging enabled.

julia ops: Canary plan: two non-prod tenants mirroring Voyager prefixes, synthetic flap generator, enable verbose BGP and controller logs, add Grafana panels for peer_flap_rate and stale_route_count. Canary start target 2026-06-08.

alex m: Short-term mitigation: disable aggressive prune for peers restarted within 10m and add high-sev alert on route anomalies. Sanjay, add tradeoff notes in RFC about delayed cleanup.

sanjay r: Will include toggles per-tenant and unit + integration tests. Creating ticket RW-8201 for trace artifacts and RW-8202 for the RFC.

maria g: Vendor response: NX-700 firmware v4.0.2 improves session backoff; graceful-restart is configurable now. They recommend applying during maintenance. If customer declines, we'll enable controller fallback.

julia ops: Updated action tracker with owners, PR links, canary schedule, and CS contact. Also adding a weekly peering anomaly digest.

alex m: Reconvene 2026-06-09 to review RFC + canary readiness. Closing criteria: merged controller fix, 72h clean canary, and router config applied or fallback validated.

sanjay r: Will post PR link and CI logs here when ready.

nick support: Shared preferred windows with customer; awaiting final confirmation.

alex m: Thanks team. Post blockers here and well mark items closed after verification.
